messages:
izzy: kicking off quorum-style canary for v5.1-int4 at 7% traffic for 3h. experiment: require multiple independent signals (runtime telemetry + eval harness A + eval harness B) to agree before auto-fallback. want to avoid noisy single-signal rollbacks. thoughts? :seedling:
matthias: nice. from sims we get 33% token-cost win and p95 down 20%, but doc-summarization BLEU drops ~1.1% in some slices. curious how many "agreeing" signals we'll require.
renee: propose a 2-of-3 quorum by default: any two independent subsystems flagging regression triggers the hysteresis evaluation. independent subsystems = {runtime metrics, eval-A (human-like test set), eval-B (production shadow compare)}.
omar: infra: coldstart KV variance shows up for first 35-50m depending on shard. suggest warmup_mins=50 where we still collect signals but block auto-fallback. emit alerts during warmup.
izzy: agree on warmup. also want a sample floor n>=180 for slice-level auto actions. small slices must be manual.
matthias: for hysteresis, require 3 consecutive 4m windows meeting quorum to auto-fallback. but allow 1-window immediate rollback for critical slices if both eval harnesses agree and delta > 1.0% rel.
renee: add bootstrap CI gating: the metric delta must have its 90% CI lower bound exceed threshold to count as a positive vote. avoids flukes.
omar: rollback plan: graceful stepdown 60%->30%->0 over 2m with rate-limited reroutes (max 10k requests/min) to protect backends. backfill route to pinned fp32 v5.0. ensure cache-warmback policy enabled.
izzy: plus a shadow-replay sanity step: if quorum triggered, run a quick 10-minute synthetic replay on a reserved runner to confirm before final rollback. balances safety and speed.
matthias: add "decay-to-stricter" guard: if canary exceeds 75m, reduce thresholds by 15% (tighten) to catch slow drift.
renee: safety budget: each team gets 3 auto-fallback allowances per rolling 7d window. after budget exhausted, future canaries require manual approval for 24h. implement simple counter in controller.
izzy: telemetry: tag each auto-fallback event with which subsystems voted, CI bounds, sample sizes, and the safety-budget counter at event time. helps postmortems.
omar: ops: route alerts to #canary-quorum; keep critical-slice alerts unmuted. we will also post a short webhook to #incident-ops when a quorum is reached (but before rollback) so oncall can intervene in the 10m replay window.
renee: config blob for controller (string only): ```json
{"quorum_mode":"2_of_3","subsystems":["runtime","evalA","evalB"],"warmup_mins":"50","hysteresis_windows":"3","window_mins":"4","sample_floor":"180","critical_immediate_vote":"evalA+evalB","critical_rel_threshold":"0.01","ci_method":"bootstrap_90","stepdown":"60,30,0","stepdown_duration_mins":"2","max_reroute_qps":"10000","replay_confirm_mins":"10","tighten_after_mins":"75","tighten_factor":"0.85","safety_budget_week":"3"}
```
matthias: small tweak: make subsystems labels configurable per model since some models only have one eval harness. also document fallback precedence when fewer subsystems exist.
izzy: good point. we'll add a fallback to require unanimous agreement if only two subsystems present.
ops-bot: canary started at 4977654321 -> 7% traffic. dashboard: https://console/redwood/canary/4977654321
izzy: action items: Matthias to parameterize subsystems, Omar to implement warmup + replay step + rate limits, Renee to wire safety-budget counter + telemetry tags. check back after 3h smoke. :rocket:
